scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:lore && bun run typecheck:lore-tests && bun run typecheck:scripts && bun run typecheck:dashboard && bun run typecheck:dashboard-tests && bun run typecheck:dashboard-e2e
scripts.check:live-repo-state: bun scripts/check-claude-md-live-sweep.ts && bun scripts/check-list-json-real-corpus-buffer.ts && bun scripts/check-phase-write-live-state.ts && bun scripts/check-live-mirror-integrity.ts && bun scripts/check-live-corpus-detectors.ts

documentedScripts.dev: Run the lore CLI from source; arguments after the script name go to lore.
documentedScripts.build: Compile the standalone binary to dist/lore.
documentedScripts.typecheck: Run tsc over core, lore (src and tests), scripts and the dashboard (src, tests, e2e).
documentedScripts.test:vitest: Build dist/lore, then run every test file: vitest on Bun, then vitest on Node for the files in vitest.node-files.ts, then the test-file census.
documentedScripts.test: Take the checkout's oracle lock, then run each check script and test:vitest in a fixed order; every step runs and a per-step exit table prints.
documentedScripts.test:changed: Select and run the tests a change can affect, printing a reason per file; --list previews, an optional ref sets the diff base.
documentedScripts.test:file: Run the named test files, each on the runner that collects it (Bun, or Node for files in vitest.node-files.ts); -t <name> and other flags pass through.
documentedScripts.check:floor: Install, build, typecheck and the two diff-scoped :changed checks (the integrate floor); --list prints the step names.
documentedScripts.check:plan-close: Run every check: script the integrate floor does not (the plan-close chain); --list prints the names.
documentedScripts.check:memory-files: Run `lore context refresh --check`: exit 1 when CLAUDE.md or a lore rules file differs from a fresh refresh, or the root file is over its ceiling.
